      {"text": "Optimized PC-treated devices achieved a champion efficiency of 25.3%.", "anchor": "Optimized PC‐treated devices achieved a champion efficiency of 25.3%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "PC-treated devices retained 95% of initial efficiency after 100 cycles of thermal shock.", "anchor": "PC‐treated devices retained 95% of initial efficiency after 100 cycles of TS", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The strategy combines CeOx nanoparticles with PEAI to form a hybrid surface treatment for PTAA-based n-i-p PSCs.", "anchor": "combines nanoparticle cerium oxide (CeO x ) with phenylethylammonium iodide (PEAI) to form a hybrid surface treatment (PC) for poly[bis(4‐phenyl)(2,4,6‐trimethylphenyl)amine (PTAA) based n‐i‐p PSC architecture", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]

      {"text": "Under thermal aging at 65°C, devices demonstrate a T90 lifetime exceeding 1100 h.", "anchor": "Under thermal aging at 65°C, devices further demonstrate a T 90 lifetime exceeding 1100 h", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

      {"text": "The device exhibits one of the highest fill factors of 87.04% reported so far.", "anchor": "one of the highest fill factors of 87.04% reported so far", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The modified device features excellent thermal and operational stability.", "anchor": "the modified device features an excellent thermal and operational stability", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

    "claims": [
      {"text": "Single-junction WBG perovskite devices with bandgaps of 1.67 and 1.84 eV achieve PCEs of 23.17% and 19.61%.", "anchor": "single-junction WBG perovskite devices with bandgaps of 1.67 and 1.84 eV achieve champion power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of 23.17% and 19.61%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Monolithic perovskite-silicon TSCs enable PCEs of 33.21% (certified 32.13%) for rigid and 31.03% (certified 30.34%) for flexible tandems.", "anchor": "the strategy enables PCEs of 33.21% (certified 32.13%) for rigid tandems and 31.03% (certified 30.34%) for flexible tandems", "evidence_type": "measurement"},

    ]

      {"text": "Inverted PSCs with F-4PABTI deliver a champion PCE of 26.76%.", "anchor": "the inverted PSCs with F‐4PABTI deliver a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.76%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The large area device (1 cm²), module (655.2 cm²), and wide-bandgap device (1.84 eV) achieve PCEs of 25.38%, 20.59%, and 17.87%.", "anchor": "the large area device (1 cm 2 ), module (655.2 cm 2 ), and wide‐bandgap device (1.84 eV) achieve excellent PCEs of 25.38%, 20.59%, and 17.87%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The champion device exhibits a high VOC of 1.203 V.", "anchor": "a high open‐circuit voltage ( V OC ) of 1.203 V", "evidence_type": "measurement"}

  {

      {"text": "BTP passivates undercoordinated Pb²⁺ ions at the buried interface via Lewis acid–base interactions.", "anchor": "BTP also passivates undercoordinated Pb 2+ ions at the buried interface via Lewis acid–base interactions", "evidence_type": "inference"}

      {"text": "PSCs incorporating the co-assembled layer achieve a PCE of 25.8%.", "anchor": "Perovskite solar cells incorporating this co‐assembled layer achieve a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.8%", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices retain over 90% of initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous illumination.", "anchor": "retain over 90% of their initial efficiency after 1000 h of continuous illumination or over 80% after 1000 h of aging at 85°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The co-assembly is composed of ammonium-functionalized (CzPACl) and flexible oligo(ethylene glycol) (CzOEG) monomers.", "anchor": "a carbazole-derived supramolecular co-assembly composed of ammonium-functionalized (CzPACl) and flexible oligo(ethylene glycol) (CzOEG) monomers", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]

      {"text": "The device achieves 26.81% efficiency with T93 lifetime over 1140 h under standard illumination at 85°C.", "anchor": "the resulting device achieves an efficiency of 26.81% with T 93 lifetime over 1140 h under standard illumination at 85°C", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TFIBA is devised as an inhibitor to construct precise iodide ion traps on perovskite surfaces via directional halogen bonding.", "anchor": "2,3,5,6‐tetrafluoro‐4‐iodobenzamide (TFIBA) is innovatively devised as an inhibitor to construct precise iodide ion traps on perovskite surfaces via directional halogen bonding", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "FPIFA serves as a dopant ensuring rapid and controllable p-doping of spiro-OMeTAD without air assistance.", "anchor": "(bis(trifluoroacetoxy)iodo)pentafluorobenzene (FPIFA) as an ideal dopant ensures rapid and controllable p‐doping of spiro‐OMeTAD without air assistance", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]

  {

      {"text": "Two novel SAMs, 4PCzBr and 6PCzBr, were designed with precisely tailored ESP distributions.", "anchor": "we designed two novel SAMs, 4PCzBr and 6PCzBr, with precisely tailored ESP distributions", "evidence_type": "inference"},
      {"text": "Compared to conventional carbazole-based SAMs, the designs substantially elevate the average PCE of both OSCs and PSCs.", "anchor": "Compared to conventional carbazole-based SAMs, these designs substantially elevate the average power conversion efficiency (PCE) of both organic solar cells (OSCs) and PSCs", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The SAMs integrate a rigid, planar perylenocarbazole core with extended π-conjugation, alkyl chain optimization, and bromination.", "anchor": "By integrating a rigid, planar perylenocarbazole (PCz) core with extended π-conjugation, alkyl chain optimization, and bromination", "evidence_type": "inference"}
